jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: This is a full-time Senior Data Engineer position at Flybuys in Melbourne, VIC. Flybuys is known as the country's most popular rewards program. Help train less experienced engineers in the squad. Solid DevOps experience (building pipelines and using IAC infrastructure as code), Previous experience using Airflow, Relevant experience in data warehousing and data management technologies, such as Snowflake, Must have hands-on experience working with Python programming language. The company values ways of working that work for everyone and use different strengths to make teams stronger, working to ensure everyone's voice is heard and respected equally regardless of identity, background, position, ability or lifestyle.

jobs.title: Business Analysis & Business Intelligence - Graduate Program
jobs.description: As an FDM Business Intelligence Consultant, you'll play a pivotal role in analysing and interpreting data to improve the operations and the performance of your company. You'll collaborate closely with the IT team to develop strategies to help the business gain and maintain competitive advantage. Your journey begins with training out of FDM's Academy, you'll receive the chance to gain industry recognised qualifications, as well as mentoring and support throughout, and after successfully completing your training, you'll have the technical and professional skills you need to step into an integral position with one or more of their industry-leading, multinational clients in Australia during the two-year program. The program requires a commitment to completing the full 2.5-year graduate program, with geographic flexibility throughout Sydney and Melbourne to support top-tier clients.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Build creative and pleasing visualizations to effectively communicate data asset design detail to support data understanding and asset exploit by BI report developers, Data Scientists, etc. Additionally, responsibilities include communicating and maintaining Master Data, Meta Data, Data Management Repositories, Logical Data Models, and Data Standards, creating and maintaining optimal data pipeline architecture, assembling large complex data sets that meet functional/non-functional business requirements, and identifying, designing, and implementing internal process improvements such as automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, and redesigning infrastructure for greater scalability. The position requires hands-on knowledge of tools to perform data quality, data cleansing, data wrangling and data standards, with technology skills in Big Data, Snowflake, Informatica/Talend/Data Stage/ETL tools. Qualifications include a degree in Computer Engineering, Mathematics or other engineering disciplines with significant experience in programming.

jobs.title: 豆包大模型应用架构工程师
jobs.description: 大模型应用架构工程师-豆包大模型，Base地为北京、杭州、上海均可选择。职位主要负责：1、LLM在toC应用落地，提供多tool（联网、文件识别、代码沙盒等）与多模型的动态编排能力；2、与不同LLM算法同学紧密协作，探索复杂服务能力，如WebGPT、FunctionCall、Agents、AssistantAPI、图像/语音多模态等；3、设计并实施全流式通信的LLM应用架构，与国内最大规模的LLM高性能推理服务联动。职位要求：熟练掌握Linux环境下的C/C++、Python、Java、Go中的1~2门；对在线架构有丰富经验，有对话系统、搜广推推荐系统经验优先。具有独立解决问题的能力，良好的团队合作精神；有强烈的工作责任心，较好的学习能力、沟通能力和自驱力。

jobs.title: 推荐算法工程师实习
jobs.description: 岗位职责包括：基于海量用户行为数据，进行用户音乐的数据挖掘和分析；优化现有推荐召回、排序、重排策略和算法；跟踪业界前沿技术的发展，探索前沿算法在音乐/社交推荐场景落地和实践。岗位要求包括：本科以上学历，计算机相关专业；熟悉Python/C++/go中的一种或多种编程技术；熟悉大数据处理技术；对大数据开源组件有使用经验；了解DeepFM/DIN/YoutubeDNN等算法，有推荐算法经验者优先。

jobs.title: AI Agent研发工程师实习生
jobs.description: 负责AI Agent的设计与研发，包括感知-决策-执行闭环、多智能体协作、长期记忆与推理机制；研究ReAct、AutoGPT、CoT等前沿范式，熟练掌握LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI等Agent开发框架；优化大模型在Agent任务中的规划、工具调用、反思、代码生成等核心能力；推动Agent在搜索、对话、办公、数据平台、网盘文库、生活娱乐等产品场景中的规模化应用；探索RAG与Agent融合架构；建设Agent评测体系。

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师实习生
jobs.description: The position involves responsibility for applying large model capabilities in generation, understanding, and interaction across core business scenarios through large model fine-tuning, innovative structure design and development, and new training and inference paradigms; building LLM and derivative application technology modules within the company including Agents and RAG; tracking cutting-edge industry technology research and development; optimizing business scenarios; and producing high-level papers for publication at top international conferences. Candidates should be doctoral or master's students in Computer Science or related fields; have strong engineering implementation ability with familiarity of LLM basic principles and large model fine-tuning techniques; be familiar with at least one mainstream programming language such as C/C++, Python, or Java.

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师（金融科技）实习
jobs.description: Key duties include completing SFT and DPO dataset construction and training for various business scenarios, building AI automated evaluation pipelines for full-chain automation iteration, and exploring cutting-edge large model training and inference technologies including inference optimization and efficient pruning/quantization acceleration. Requirements: Master's degree or above in computer science, AI, data science, statistics or related fields; proficiency in Python/Java/C++ and at least one programming language; familiarity with LLM technologies including SFT, RLHF, DPO, planning and agents; and mastery of deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow/PyTorch. GPU training cluster resources available. Business scenarios include AI search, intelligent customer service, intelligent Q&A assistants, and large model platform.
